# Yellowbrick

> Specialized mental health treatment program for emerging adults in Chicago offering residential, outpatient, and integrated psychiatric care.

Yellowbrick is a comprehensive mental health treatment center serving emerging adults (ages 18-30) in the Chicago area. The program combines psychiatric care, therapy, life skills training, and creative expression through an integrated treatment model, with evidence-based approaches and university partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Emerging adults
- Residential treatment
- Psychiatric care
- Bipolar disorder
- Major depressive disorder
- Anxiety disorders
- Thought disorders
- Evidence-based treatment
- Therapeutic community
- PHP (Partial Hospitalization Program)
- IOP (Intensive Outpatient Program)
- Treatment outcomes
- Chicago-based care
- Integrated treatment model
- Neuromodulation
